name: io.github.ant-dev-lab/nightmarquee
description: Cinematic website prompts as slash commands, tuned for Lovable, Bolt, Cursor and Claude.

environmentVariables.name: NIGHTMARQUEE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token for headless or CI use. On a workstation run nightmarquee_sign_in instead.

environmentVariables.name: NIGHTMARQUEE_NO_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to stop sending the anonymous install ID and MCP client name.

environmentVariables.name: NIGHTMARQUEE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in ms, default 10000. Invalid values fall back to the default.
